hero.description: Expand international partner networks, promote student exchange, and bring international standard experiences to 5 campuses nationwide.

about.headline: Pioneering university in technology talent training, closely associated with businesses and global partner networks.
about.description: The International Relations Department connects FPT University with universities, organizations, and enterprises worldwide — from student exchange and research collaboration to campus visits at 5 facilities.

campus.title: 5 campuses nationwide
campus.subtitle: From Hanoi to Can Tho — each campus is a unique space for learning, working, and welcoming international partners according to distinct standards.

partners.title: Partners & International Cooperation
partners.subtitle: A strong network of partners with universities and enterprises locally and internationally, providing numerous practical experience opportunities.

process.title: Visit Request Process
process.subtitle: Simple and transparent — from request submission to the actual visit.
process.step1Desc: Fill out visit registration and delegation details via the online form.
process.step2Desc: International Relations Department receives and reviews the partner's request.
process.step3Desc: A host is assigned to prepare for and welcome the delegation.
process.step4Desc: The visit schedule is confirmed and sent back to the partner.

cta.title: Ready to connect with FPT University?
cta.subtitle: Register for a visit or contact the International Relations Department directly to begin our partnership journey.

ADMIN.step1: Manage user accounts and system permissions.
ADMIN.step2: Configure the integration APIs (OCR, translation, etc.).
ADMIN.step3: Monitor system activity logs and security.

HO.step1: Track cross-campus visit requests within your scope.
HO.step2: Manage the news and FAQs shown publicly to partners.
HO.step3: Update campus information whenever it changes.
HO.step4: Monitor reception progress through the Dashboard.

STAFF_LEADER.step1: Approve new visit requests within the campus.
STAFF_LEADER.step2: Assign the Host responsible for receiving each delegation.
STAFF_LEADER.step3: Manage accounts and departments within the campus.
STAFF_LEADER.step4: Update the Gallery and news introducing the campus.

STAFF.step1: Check the visit requests assigned to you.
STAFF.step2: Prepare the reception programme before the visit date.
STAFF.step3: Record minutes, news and photos after the visit.

DEPT_LEADER.step1: Assign department personnel to support visiting delegations.
DEPT_LEADER.step2: Track the tasks and progress of your department.
DEPT_LEADER.step3: Sign the handover once the support work is complete.
DEPT_LEADER.step4: Coordinate with the International Relations Department (IC) when needed.

DEPT_STAFF.step1: View the support schedule assigned by your department.
DEPT_STAFF.step2: Respond to assigned tasks on time.
DEPT_STAFF.step3: Sign for receipt / return when handing over work.
DEPT_STAFF.step4: Update the support results once completed.

STUDENT.step1: Check your delegation support invitations in the Dashboard.
STUDENT.step2: Accept or decline the invitation before the response deadline.
STUDENT.step3: Review the confirmed support schedule and prepare as instructed by the Host.
STUDENT.step4: Join the delegation support at the scheduled time and place.

cta.title: Ready to continue working?
